summary: @or-sdk/invitations preinstall downloads Bun and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: On `npm install`, the package's preinstall script `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime, stages it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotating string-array with a `WV8StW` rotator, hex-mangled identifiers). The payload name and content are unrelated to the advertised 'Invitations SDK' purpose. `setup.mjs` itself is transformed with obfuscator.io-style renaming (`_0x488df8`, nested per-function string tables) despite performing only download-and-exec logic. Using an alternate language runtime to execute an opaque bundle bypasses Node-based inspection of reachable code, and the flow fires automatically on default install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
